save.text: Sam voice-directing DreamWorks cartoon 'Home' announced to release in ~1 week (Sam confirmed).
Critical Role episode count: tonight is ep 47; 50th episode upcoming with surprises and Critmas afterward (Matt announced).

Pre-order deadline confusion for Gilmore's Glorious Goods shirts: deadline stated as 'tomorrow at midnight' (Travis), cast unsure if that's tonight or tomorrow night; Matt advises order tonight to be safe.
Marisha's last episode of Signal Boost is this Tuesday; she rotates hosts but will continue producing it (Marisha confirmed).
Marisha is assisting Pyrah tribe rebuilding stone shelters after the battle; she didn't use any 5th-level spells (Marisha/Matt confirmed).
Gern Blanston left the party, went into the Cindergrove to collect red dragon scales and hasn't been seen since (Matt confirmed).
Scanlan casts Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion to shelter group; can include entire Pyrah tribe (~35 people) if designated (Sam/Matt confirmed).
Scanlan's mansion is on another plane, appears grand with ethereal servants; some villagers hesitated to enter (Matt/Sam observed).
Some Pyrah refugees declined Scanlan's offer and continued building shelters; Scanlan attempted to invite all including immediate family (Matt/Sam/Marisha observed).
Scanlan's mansion servants are 'slave ghosts' commanded by him; he claims ~100 servants, 50 personal, rest available (Sam demonstrated; Matt described servants).
Servants respond to commands, perform tasks (braid chest hair, fetch ale/food); some villagers hesitant to accept but food appears then dissipates when Marisha opens door (Sam/Matt/Marisha observed).
Scanlan has individualized rooms upstairs; mentions reserved rooms for Pike and Kaylie across from his (Sam stated).
Keyleth returns with stray Pyrah members; some inspect mansion, some keep building outside for future shelters; party offered to rest for evening (Matt announced).
Mansion door is protected: only invited can enter (Laura asked, Sam confirmed).

Levita/Trinket lodging: Scanlan initially forgot Trinket's room; Kaylie's room locked; front hall/high ceilings and large basement exist; Laura moves bed to basement for Trinket training (Sam/Laura/Matt).
Scanlan can provide up to five servants to a person on task; they fetched one spectral cow collectively (Sam/Matt/Travis).
Basement training chamber discovered beneath mansion: sand pit, training dummies, chains, weapon rack, armor (Matt described).
Trinket trained with Grog: Trinket attack +8; ram hit Grog (23 to hit) for 7 bludgeoning; Grog made Str save 26 and stayed standing (Matt/Laura/Travis).
Scanlan has a trombone/music room available; Sam owns a trombone and performed a sad trombone sound (Sam/Matt/Liam).
Laura borrowed Gern's flying enchanted broom; enchantment requires a spoken phrase in archaic Draconic meaning 'candle' to activate (Matt/Sam/Laura observed).
Scanlan examined broom: Arcana 14 -> enchanted; Investigation 21 -> found hidden non-Common phrase in runes; identified phrase language as archaic Draconic (Sam checks, Matt confirms).
Laura successfully activated broom with the Draconic word and briefly lifted off the bed; Scanlan present and assisted (Matt/Sam/Laura observed).

Laura successfully flew Gern's enchanted broom in mansion room; ceilings ~50 ft; she made a Dex check (20) and learned handling takes practice; Scanlan noted she stole broom and promised to mark a debt to repay by helping others (Laura/Scanlan/Matt observed).
Later that night Keyleth was knocked on by Cerkonos, who has a regenerating arm (previously burned off) and asked to speak privately (Cerkonos/Marisha/Matt observed).
(replaced) Pre-order confusion for Gilmore shirts: deadline phrasing 'tomorrow at midnight' led to cast advising to order tonight to be safe (Travis/Matt noted earlier).

Cerkonos (headmaster) revealed a Pyrah trainee named Raishan joined ~4 years ago at ~15, now ~19–20, appeared human but later used ancient arcane powers to tear open the Gate and was associated with Thordak's emergence (Cerkonos told Keyleth).
Raishan's name used during Conclave attack on Emon and linked to a green dragon that initiated that assault (Matt confirmed to Marisha).
Keyleth/Vox link: Raven Queen dream for Vax indicating destiny/fate choices (Raven Queen vision during sleep sequence; Matt narrated).

Laura/Vex stole Gern's enchanted broom (necromancer/candlemaker); she can fly with it and intends to keep it. Group debated leaving items in Scanlan's mansion to test permanence (Trinket/broom considered).
Morning in Scanlan's mansion: lavish breakfast prepared by servants; party mostly rested. Grog had a vivid dream of Kevdak and corpses (Grog/Matt described).
Pre-order confusion for Gilmore shirts: deadline phrasing 'tomorrow at midnight' led to cast advising to order tonight to be safe (Travis/Matt noted earlier).

Laura (Vex) successfully flies Gern's enchanted broom over breakfast room; made Dex checks (13, then 13) and fired an arrow with disadvantage (attack roll 16) that stuck into a turkey; practice needed for stability; Percy (Trinket training/seat engineering) offered to build a seat and help (Laura/Marisha/Taliesin/Matt observed).
Raishan infiltrated Fire Ashari ~4 years ago posing as a 15-year-old human woman; later ripped open the rift and vanished (Marisha relayed; Sam/Taliesin/Laura engaged).
Fire Ashari discovered her powers exceeded their druidic capabilities; Cerkonos found her ripping open the rift as mountain erupted (Marisha reported).
Party next destinations discussed: retrieve Titanstone Knuckles from Kevdak/Pyrah tribe (Grog's tribe) and consult sphinx in Whitestone (party discussed; Marisha/Sam/Travis/Laura confirmed).
Party decides to travel toward Westruun to search for Grog's herd (group consensus; Grog enthusiastic).
Grog's herd wanders Silvercut Roadway west of Westruun, south of Kraghammer, east of Emon; herd size ~6 (Matt/Travis stated).
Discussion of avoiding immediate recognition: suggestion to use Hat of Disguise to conceal Grog's identity; Grog resists hiding (Taliesin/Sam/Travis dialogue).
Party decides to prioritize the sphinx (Frostweald) to retrieve vestiges; plan: travel there next (Sam decided).
Osysa (not 'Odessa') clarified as correct name; she has locations of other vestiges, not the vestige itself (Laura/Sam/Matt clarified).
Marisha failed to recall any specific tree in Frostweald (Int check 9); GM noted likely tree locations: Crossroads, Bramblewood Forest, areas northwest/west of Westruun (Marisha/Matt).

Party uses Keyleth's Wind Walk to become mist forms and travel over Bramblewood toward Westruun; mist travel is slightly faster than horse (~under a day by horse, mist faster) (Matt/Marisha/Sam present).

They exited Bramblewood and observed a green field with a 15–20 ft patch of disturbed ground containing wooden spikes, glimmering items, grooves, and two people removing a cart from the site (Matt described while mist-forming).

Keyleth failed to scry on a Westruun park tree; found another connection at Bramblewood entrance trees with distinct markings, enabling the portal through a petrified tree into the Bramblewood (Marisha/Matt noted).
Vex/Vax notice farm offerings site with large claw-sweep marks; likely dragon activity (Vex/Taliesin Investigation rolls 16/18).

Westruun outskirts: some farmlands intentionally burned; armed guards watch working farmers and one guard shoved a farmer—suggests coerced labor/lockdown; thin external battlement wall around city entrances observed (Perception group, Vex/Vax high checks).

Party lands from mist-form near corn/high-stalk fields and all revert to physical form; Pass Without a Trace cast by Vex; group rolls high Stealth (most 18+), proceeding to investigate farms stealthily.
Farmers near fields are being forced to provide food to the city; guards/enforcers working for the dragon take people and enforce contributions (farmer 'Reginald' described; party overheard).

Farmer 'Reginald' (late 40s/50s, gray beard, bruised face) reports his daughter and others taken by the dragon's enforcers; last dragon sighting ~dusk yesterday; dragon visits every few days. (Reginald spoke to party ~turns 1203–1271).

Enforcers include half-orcs; they take useful people and sometimes slaughter as warnings; exact leader unknown. They maintain a holding site just inside the city outskirts (farmer pointed toward city/outskirts).
